span.p:
SC-007 happy path, must
Given A freight operations manager has an idea for a tool that recovers late loads. They have never written a PRD, and the quarterly planning meeting is one week away.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: When They say they want to turn the idea into a specification.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: They state the idea in their own words and name their domain, freight operations

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: They see every section of the new set, each marked as not started

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: For each section, they are taught what it is for, then asked one or two questions at a time

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: After each section, they read the draft as prose and see its grade and every blocking defect by name

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: They answer the one question that most improves each weak section, and see it re-graded

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: With every section at review, they ask for the buildability review and see that no release-line stage lacks a must requirement

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: The sponsor reads the root document, sees what is still open and who owns each open item, and approves the set at version 1.0.0

div.style: color: rgb(31, 36, 48) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; width: 300px;

span.p: Then Every section is at final, every gap the buildability review found is closed or owned by a named decider, and the change log records the sponsor's approval against a named version.
